title: Making Agent Skills Secure - How Tessl and Snyk Are Solving The Next Big Security Issue
description:
Are your AI agents running vulnerable skills? According to recent findings, 13.4% of all published skills harbor at least one critical security vulnerability. Even smaller vulnerabilities, if chained together, can lead to significantly destructive attack chains. This makes security in AI agents a crucial challenge that developers must address head-on.

In this video, Snyk's Brian provides a deep dive into how Model Context Protocols (MCPs) and skills are pivotal in supply chain security concerns. Through an integration between Tessl and Snyk, every skill on the Tessl registry undergoes automatic security scanning, ensuring developers have the necessary data to make informed choices before integrating skills into their environments.

What we cover:
• The prevalence of security vulnerabilities in published skills
• The significance of MCPs in supply chain security
• How Snyk and Tessl are collaborating to ensure skill security
• Why even minor vulnerabilities can be dangerous
• How to use the Tessl registry for insight on skill security

Visit tessl.io/registry to browse skills and check their Snyk scan results today.
